title: Leadership Dynamics — Leading Through Uncertainty
tagline: A school of sharks moves with intent and communication.
summary: Emotionally intelligent leadership is a prerequisite for navigating disruption, financial crises, and organizational change. Cross-functional coordination is cited as the fastest-growing skill for 2026.

learningObjectives.statement: Apply high-performance soft skills — psychological safety, purposeful inquiry, and productive disagreement — within a team scenario.
Apply conversational-repair techniques (keyword highlighting, options, explanations, escalation) to rebuild a working alliance after a breakdown.
Design a cross-functional coordination plan that aligns multiple functions under time and resource pressure.

activities.title: Psychological safety, purposeful inquiry, productive disagreement
Run a team check-in that surfaces a hidden concern safely
The repair toolkit and when to escalate to a human
Recover a derailed conversation with the Apex Mentor
Draft a coordination plan for a 2-week crunch scenario

assessments.method: Annotated transcript of a team interaction labeling each soft-skill move
assessments.successCriteria: Identifies at least one instance each of safety, inquiry, and productive disagreement.

assessments.method: Repair exercise: rewrite a broken-down exchange using two repair techniques
assessments.successCriteria: Applies two distinct repair techniques that plausibly rebuild the alliance.

assessments.method: Submit a cross-functional coordination plan for the crunch scenario
assessments.successCriteria: Plan names functions, dependencies, decision owners, and a communication cadence.
